title: Mobile App Developer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Mobile App Developer (React Native) to join our engineering team and build high-quality mobile applications for digital lending, financial services, and enterprise platforms. You will work closely with product managers, backend developers, and QA engineers to deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly mobile experiences across Android and iOS devices. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using React Native. Build responsive and user-friendly mobile interfaces. Integrate mobile applications with REST APIs and backend services. Implement new features and enhance existing functionality. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues. Optimize application performance and user experience. Integrate third-party libraries and SDKs. Participate in code reviews and development discussions. Support application deployment and release activities. 
 
 What we're looking for 
 1-3 years of experience in mobile application development. Strong proficiency in JavaScript and modern ES6+ concepts. Hands-on experience with React Native and ReactJS. Basic knowledge of Java programming. Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive UI development. Experience integrating RESTful APIs and third-party libraries. Knowledge of Android and iOS application deployment processes. Experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Git version control. Good communication and teamwork skills. 
 
 Nice to have 
 TypeScript experience. Knowledge of Redux or Context API. Firebase services experience. Understanding of mobile application security best practices. Experience publishing applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store. Exposure to fintech, lending, banking, or financial services applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. 

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.

Key Skills: UI development,Backend,Version control,Javascript,Application security,Product design,Financial services,Android
